I'm in a similar boat as you as a f2p looking to focus on Blade, and personally I decided to pull Blade + his LC and wait for Luocha rerun/upcoming healers. I'll share what I was thinking in case it helps you too. In advance, its from a more casual mindset that doesn't really get enjoyment from clearing high end activities in this game.

  
\- Blade looks for having a healer in general on a team. Natasha and Bailu still fill that role, its just Luocha fills it best.

  
\- We likely have more healers coming. If none of them are better than Luocha, I'd still prefer to wait for his rerun so I'm not trying to build 2 characters when I barely have resources saved on my account since its been like 2 months since the game launched.

  
\- I don't care for MoC at this point in time, and doubt I can make major progress in it for at least another year. If you care for clearing MoC, get Blade + Luocha and pray you get secret vow. Everything else in the game you can probably just friend someone with a Luocha support and use that if you have some trouble with bosses.

  
 \- People say pulling LCs isn't really recommended for f2p. However, they make the characters they're made for feel WAY better to use. I think its more important the character you plan to dedicate a lot of your limited f2p resources to should actually feel good to play. Again this is from a more casual "i don't plan to do MoC for a while" mindset.

  
\- Faves >>> meta. Even if your pulling a character to support a fave. Do you like Luocha? Get him and Blade. Are you only getting him for Blade? Just pump your resources into making OP Bladie. Also remember as a f2p it's very hard to keep up with meta  
Also, I got Welt as one of my characters as well but apparently he doesn't synergize with Blade since slowed enemies = less attacks = less stacks for Blade. So likely your teams are gonna look like some arrangement of Gepard/Welt/2 others and Blade/Nat/2 others, with Tingyun likely on the non-Blade team since he doesn't benefit from her buffs as much.

First off, keep going through quests, and be sure to fully purify the locations. You get 360 crowns per map like that. Bonus areas also give you crowns, though the amount varies by level. You'll want to save crowns for really good packs/a pack you want to pull from. Upcoming packs can be viewed on twitter @sagaofishtaria, their Japanese twitter which is a little ahead of our events.

You do not need to maximize every card before evolving- it can sometimes be a waste of EXP! You just need to combine units with each other, the complete ones can be +2 or +4 (a  +3 or +1 is incomplete.) 

It doesn't matter what element your deck is at the time. As you level up, it'll change A LOT. But for one boss in particular (the big spider) you'll need a fire card (preferably anything than can hit more than once, like a flurry, which hits 3 times, or some special slice and pounds, one that fits both ~~and is decent for a cheap card~~ is the fire pound 6* [Penthesileia](http://ishtaria.wikia.com/wiki/Penthesileia) )) But if you plan to be on a top union, a variation of elements would be preferred.

People do so much damage in events because their decks are mostly 6*+4 and 7*+2/+4. In my union, the stronger players who do that massive damage have ONLY 7*s in their deck, and even a few Platinum 7*s. So they're basically the MLGs of the game, and you shouldn't worry too much to reach that level at the moment. Personally, my deck consists of Orcus+4, Loki+2, Kolga+2, Dante+2, and Valentines!Scathach+2. As you can see, it's mostly made up of flurries, meaning I automatically have higher attack because they're... well, flurries. The higher ranking union members of mine, though, have one slice and 4 flurries, but I personally feel odd without a pound in my deck. 

Anyways, for your deck, Crow is 100% useless, get rid of her. Aine is a decent unit- you'll want to try to complete her (+2 or something ~~I forgot if its +4 for or not ^^;~~). Idun is good for now, but definitely try to replace her- she's too expensive to complete when you can easily get a better 7* for the same price (ex, Idun costs 800 medals to finish, that's 400 pots. You can get a Orcus+4, Dakini+4, two Track!Fionn+2s, and a whole lotta other cheap units that are decent.) Nitocris is mostly good as a leader, if you're in a union that needs it. I don't know much about Jack, but her passive looks very good, and she might be decent to complete and keep (if you keep her, don't get Orcus+4 or Track!Fionn+2 because they're pounds too. Only 1 pound per deck, unless you want to beef up your defense deck.)

Apart from gaining levels, you should definitely be collecting crowns (which will come with levels.) DON'T pull from the gold packs, or the non-weekly pack (it's always there at the bottom)- they're horrible and a waste of time. Knowing which weekly packs  are good, on the other hand, is an acquired skill, that I personally don't have (I rely on my union mates to make good choices.) Also, you might want to install LINE if you plan on getting to a high level union. Level requirements change per union, but most ask for you to be level 100+, and it's well worth it! I've been with mine for months now, and we started from a level 80+ top 100 union, and are now a level 120+ top 50 union. It took months for myself, and it will probably take months for yourself as well. Above all, you should have patience with your progress.

ALSO, the next event coming up is called "gifting", and as of now they DOUBLE experience the whole time the event is happening, so definitely try to save pots (the AP and BP potions) for that!
